# ab-significance

> Pure-Python significance tests for prompt or model variants: Wilson and Newcombe intervals, two-proportion z, Welch t, seeded permutation tests Python package `trysac-ab-significance`, import name `ab_significance`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
